feed.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: What happened to article 16 before and at the Special Town Meeting of August 22, 2016?

entry.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R: Finance Committee, 2016-08-11
entry.summary: Article 16 Lanni Orchards APR local match. Town to fund a local 10% match toward the Agricultural Preservation Restriction, funds already held in reserve since last year.

entry.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R: Select Board, 2016-08-09
entry.summary: Recommend approval of Article 16 (10% local match for Lanni Orchards agricultural preservation restriction) — passed

entry.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R: Select Board, 2016-08-02
entry.summary: Town share costs covered in FY 2016. The town covered its share of the Lanni Orchards APR, the Summer Street design, and architectural services for the track and field project.

entry.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R: Select Board, 2016-07-19
entry.summary: Commonwealth proposed APR purchase, Lanni Orchards. Boards were asked for feedback on the proposed purchase of the agricultural preservation restriction; no dollar figure printed.

entry.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R: Select Board, 2016-07-12
entry.summary: Special Town Meeting Article 16 - Lanni Orchards APR. Article 16 appropriates a local contribution toward the Agricultural Preservation Restriction for Lanni Orchards at 292 Chase Road; Ms. Lafleur said the funding comes from the 2016 budget.

entry.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R: Planning Board, 2016-06-27
entry.summary: Support the Commonwealth's proposed acquisition of an Agricultural Preservation Restriction on Lanni Orchards, 294 Chase Road, for agricultural preservation. — passed

entry.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R: Select Board, 2016-06-07
entry.summary: The APR proposal for Lanni Orchards is to be forwarded to the Conservation Commission, Planning Board and Agricultural Commission for review and recommendation, then return to the Board.

entry.title: Article 16: Authorize the 10% local match for the Lanni Orchards Agricultural Preservation R: Select Board, 2016-05-10
entry.summary: Lanni Orchards agricultural preservation restriction match. The town is expected to make a match for the proposed state acquisition, depending on factors.
